references.text: Describes the harvest laws when Israel enters the land, using the same phrasing 'when you come into the land that I give you'
Concerns the Sabbath as a holy day for the Lord, the same concept of rest (שַׁבָּת) for the Lord
The continuation that elaborates on what the sabbatical year for the land entails in practice
The Sabbath principle applied to the workweek, the basis for the land's sabbath rest
Provisions of the sabbatical year regarding debt forgiveness, an extension of the Sabbath principle
The fulfillment of the sabbatical years that the land did not observe; the land received rest during the exile
The promise of the land that God gives to the children of Israel, the same theme of the land gift
The warning that the land will receive its sabbatical years if the people do not keep them voluntarily
